parts.summary: The comments from AdTec, Inc. oppose the proposal to sunset or cut out urban areas from E-Rate eligibility, emphasizing the program's importance for schools and libraries.

The comment opposes the proposed broad definition of Consultant in the E-Rate Program, arguing that existing systems provide necessary safeguards and transparency, and that creating new registration and tracking systems would be redundant and burdensome. The comment supports maintaining the current implementation of the program and urges the Commission to reject any proposal to limit the program.
